title: 3 PhD positions opening at QMUL in early 2027
text: I am the QMUL PI in RESILIOUS, a Horizon Europe MSCA Doctoral Network on Internet resilience. I will be recruiting three PhD students in early 2027. I am particularly interested in candidates working on Internet measurement, standardisation, governance and economics. For examples of my work related to the analysis of standardisation processes, see my publications and the IRTF RASP Research Group. I am also open to different ideas within the broad scope of RESILIOUS. If you are interested, get in touch.
